scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const m=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(m<22||m>=25){console.error('This repo requires Node.js >=22 <25. Current: '+process.versions.node); process.exit(1)}"
